purpose: Materialize exact continuous C09 validation trajectories and qualify every pose against the unchanged V8R route-conditioned support and layered collision contract before any frozen-model validation.

approval.scope: Implement, preflight and execute exactly one immutable C09 geometry qualification over 10 worlds, 1027 edges, 2054 traversals, 71 windows and 15833 frames under a 24h active, 4GiB RAM and 8GiB disk cap; zero LiDAR/model/graph/C10/M-TARE.
approval.confirmation_reference: After explaining that the model and C08 topology graph already run and that C09 geometry qualification is the next prerequisite, the user replied '继续吧那'.

raw_sources: Ten C09 graph, spline, native mesh and geometry documents whose hashes are frozen in the approved read-only manifest.
The read-only C09 continuous-contract manifest with exact route, frame, window, incidence and resource counts.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local C09 validation geometry qualification only. No model selection, parameter tuning, training, C10, planner or M-TARE use.

sampling.rule: Materialize every doubled-edge route from frozen graph/spline inputs; preserve all 15833 frames, freeze 1331 window memberships, require 14502 exterior poses bitwise exact and treat three resolutions as repeated audits.

teacher.source: No semantic teacher. Support is current traversal spline z plus sealed fta_distance_m, with incident-edge-only C1 blending inside frozen windows.
teacher.valid_mask: Every frame must pass horizontal>=0.8m, down in [0.95,1.05]m and up>=0.8m at 0.10/0.05/0.025m with unchanged continuity and resolution identity.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No model or planner consumes this run; PASS restores only C09 frozen-replay eligibility.

split.historical_pollution_audit: C09 was used for M1D checkpoint selection, so future replay can test frozen graph-builder transfer only, not strict end-to-end unseen generalization. This geometry-only operation performs no selection.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only under 4 GiB address-space cap; expected active time about 16.62h for 639 serial patches and 47499 frame-resolution audits; zero GPU.

evidence.machine_metrics: 71 windows, 2054 arc endpoints, 639 patches, ten explicit teacher/graph/sensor trajectories, 15833-row audit and complete hashes.
evidence.complete_visual_review: Ten complete XY/XZ/safety figures plus all serialized per-layer patches with seam and integrity metrics.
evidence.failure_policy: Any drift, ambiguity, non-incident merge, seam/integrity failure, exterior pose change, safety/continuity/resolution failure or resource breach seals FAIL; no world deletion, threshold/resolution change or retry.
